segments.summary: Reviewed the complete policy prologue with exact and adversarial lenses; found strong baseline rules plus unresolved projection, HITL, atomicity, and secret-remediation seams.
Reviewed recovery addenda, approval binding, and DP-002 through DP-008; precedence is clear, but acceptance coverage and trigger predicates remain incomplete.
Reviewed DP-009 through DP-016; ownership direction is strong, while cross-surface trust, concern lineage, HITL provenance, queue safety, and projection freshness lack executable oracles.
Reviewed DP-017 through DP-024; route and persistence ownership are stated, but several acceptance criteria omit research, restart, large-run, lifecycle, and privacy obligations.
Reviewed DP-025 through DP-032; exactly-once logging, Spec Lock transactionality, runtime HITL consistency, secret remediation, classifier falsifiability, and GUI classification remain gaps.
Reviewed DP-033 through DP-040; clarification gating, fallback enums, workflow display identity, mutation races, auth state transitions, and approval UX acceptance expose concrete gaps.
Reviewed DP-041 through DP-048; privacy lifecycle, scheduler fairness, retry counting, blocked/graph/git recovery, and malformed provider responses need stronger contracts; DP-042 is explicit.
Reviewed DP-049 through DP-057 plus context; matrix ambiguity, universal timeout normalization, half-defined restore overrides, and recovery CTA target/transition semantics remain unsafe.
